model.method: closed-box bathtub redistribution over the 3DEP elevation raster
notes: This is a scenario estimate, not an observed or calibrated flood forecast.
The user-specified retained-water fraction is applied uniformly to rainfall volume; no drainage, infiltration, boundary flow, or upstream inflow is modeled.

3DEP elevation is used in its native vertical datum for relative raster math. The payload's MSL-named absolute-elevation fields use that value as an approximation; no NAVD88-to-local-mean-sea-level correction was applied.
USGS gage stage is reported as context only and is not transferred from a distant gage to the local flood surface.
Groundsource footprint counts are historical context only and do not determine the scenario depth.
Contour rings contain exteriors only because the required payload format cannot encode polygon holes.
No current local WDFN gage-height observation is available; the most recent daily stage is historical and is not used to compute this estimate.
Groundsource has historical event footprints in this box but no point water-level or depth observations.

dem.payload_absolute_elevation_datum_approxi: Native DEM datum treated as local MSL for this illustrative payload; not a surveyed MSL conversion.

data_source_roles.usgs_wdfn_v1: Live/cached station and gage observations provide context; unavailable/stale gage data is not extrapolated to the bbox.
data_source_roles.usgs_3dep: Supplies the elevation raster used for terrain and bathtub raster math.
data_source_roles.groundsource: Historical event-footprint context only; no depth values are present.

interpretation: Numeric values are generated from the specified rainfall and retained-water fraction using a simplified closed-box terrain model. They are not observed, calibrated, or suitable for life-safety decisions.
